Executive Order 10800 CONTENTS
IMPLEMENTING THE GOVERNMENT  
EMPLOYEES TRAINING ACT
By virtue of the authority vested in 
me by section 301 of title 3 of the United 
States Code and by the Government Em­
ployees Training Act (72 Stat. 327), it is 
ordered as follows:
S ection  1. As used in this order, the 
term “Act” means the Government Em­
ployees Training Act (72 Stat. 327), and 
the terms “Government,” “department,” 
“employee,” “Commission,” and “train­
ing” have the meanings given to those 
terms, respectively, by section 3 of the 
Act.

clauses.label: Sec. 2.
clauses.text:
Sec. 2. The head of each department 
shall, consonant with the Act, this order, 
and the regulations of the Civil Service 
Commission issued pursuant to the Act 
and section 5 of this order:

clauses.label: (a)
clauses.text:
(a) review periodically the immediate 
and long-range needs of the department 
for employee training, and in so doing 
take special care to identify those in­
stances in which training will increase 
the economy ai\d efficiency of depart­
mental operations;

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text:
(b) formulate plans of action to meet 
such training needs;

clauses.label: (c)
clauses.text:
(c) establish and maintain, to the 
maximum extent feasible, needed train­ing programs;

clauses.label: (d)
clauses.text:
(d) establish adequate administrative 
controls to insure that training improves 
the performance of employees, and con­
tributes to the economy, efficiency, and 
effective operation of the department 
and to the attainment of its program goals;

clauses.label: (e)
clauses.text:
(e) stimulate and encourage employee 
self-development and self-training;

clauses.label: (f)
clauses.text:
(f) utilize the training facilities and 
services of other departments to the 
extent practicable, provide training fa­
cilities and services to other departments 
when practical and without interference 
with the department’ s mission, and co­
operate in the development of interde­
partmental employee training activities; and
(Continued on next page)
THE PRESIDENT
